p0.original: 第九章 动机与情绪

p3.original: 本章视频导读，请扫描二维码观看。
p3.en: Scan the QR code to watch the video introduction to this chapter.

p4.original: 在大千世界，每个人的行为表现都各不相同。究竟是什么力量帮助了大多数成功人士去战胜困境和逆境，带领他们最终获得胜利？相反，为什么少数人却做出了攻击或伤害他人的行为？毋庸置疑，动机都在其中起了重要的作用。每个正常人的行为背后必定都有某种动机，只有了解其背后的动机才能有效理解其行为。动机是行为表现的内在倾向，正是因为动机的主观性强，所以很难被推测。本章将揭开所有人都感兴趣的心理学问题——动机与情绪的神秘面纱，帮助大家了解形形色色的人：成功者、失败者、我们的家人和朋友……甚至是我们自己。
p4.en: In thousands of worlds, each person's behaviour varies. What power has helped most successful people to overcome their predicaments and adversity and lead them to victory? On the contrary, why did a few commit attacks or harm others? It goes without saying that motivations play an important role. There must be some motive behind the behaviour of every normal person, and only by understanding the underlying motives can their behaviour be effectively understood. The motive is an inherent tendency to behave, precisely because the motive is subjective and therefore difficult to speculate. This chapter will lift the psychological issues that are of interest to all — the mystery of motivation and emotion — and help you to understand people of all kinds: winners, losers, our families and friends — even ourselves.

p5.original: 本章将详细阐述引发动机的内部和外部诸多因素。动机是如何组织起来的？我们将重点介绍马斯洛需要层次理论与进化心理学相结合的新理论观点，即功能、近因和发展的因素决定了我们动机的优先级顺序；同时，本章也将阐述两个源于进化的动机：饥饿和性。它们都是生理和社会需要相结合的产物，但只有一种需要是人类生存所必需的；接着，我们将解读作为一种特殊的动机，情绪如何帮助你应对外界环境的变化并与他人交流。此外，本章带你认识大脑中两个情绪加工系统：意识和无意识通路；在本章的最后，将展现推断动机和情绪的技术手段的进展情况（测谎仪、面部识别和大脑扫描）。让我们开启美妙的解密之旅吧！
p5.en: This chapter will elaborate on the internal and external factors that trigger the motivation. How did the motive get organized? We will focus on the new theoretical perspective of Maslow's need for a hierarchy of theory and evolutionary psychology, namely, that functional, proximate and developmental factors determine the order of priority of our motivation; At the same time, this chapter will address two evolutionary motivations: hunger and sexuality. They are the product of a combination of biological and social needs, but only one is necessary for human survival; We will then interpret, as a particular motivation, how emotions help you cope with changes in the external environment and communicate with others. In addition, this chapter provides you with two emotional processing systems in the brain: consciousness and unconscious access; At the end of this chapter, progress will be shown in technical means of extrapolating motivations and emotions (false detector, facial recognition and brain scanning). Let's start a wonderful declassified trip!
